qa_pair.question: In the frozen School fixture, find the pull request that preserves intake across restarts, then inspect its unresolved discussion. Who reported the remaining data-loss problem? Answer with the display name.
Find the restart-recovery pull request in the frozen School fixture. Compare its validation statuses and policy evaluations. Which required policy rejected it? Answer with the policy display name.

Locate the restart-recovery pull request in the frozen School fixture, identify its newest iteration, and inspect that iteration's changes. What repository path was edited? Answer with the absolute repository path.
Locate the restart-recovery pull request in the frozen School fixture and read /src/queue.py at its expected source commit. What is the retry window, in seconds? Answer with an integer.

Find the failed School build for the restart-recovery branch in the frozen fixture. Inspect its timeline and retrieve the failing job's log. What assertion text explains the failure? Return the text after 'AssertionError: '.
Find the failed build on the restart-recovery branch in the frozen School fixture and inspect its artifact metadata. Which artifact contains the recovery evidence? Answer with the artifact name.
Find the active School work item about losing queued intake in the frozen fixture. Inspect its revisions. At which revision did it transition from New to Active? Answer with an integer.

Find the active School work item about losing queued intake in the frozen fixture. Follow its comment's pull-request reference and inspect that pull request. Who authored the linked change? Answer with the display name.

Locate the account-total correction pull request in the frozen School fixture and inspect its details rather than assuming the default target. Which branch does it target? Return the full refs/heads/ reference.

Find the restart-recovery pull request in the frozen School fixture, list commits on its source branch, and compare the expected source commit. What is the matching commit message? Return the exact message.
